reviews.note: Adds Iran and Venezuela to the Cuba and Russia axis.
An unmet expectation redirected to the cycle: I thought you said the Lord was coming, watch the shmita cycle.
Names the character of it for the first time: bubonic, black death serious. Earlier tellings had it airborne and AI made, which is a different disease profile.
October 2024: the plague can be lessened and prayed into. A lessened plague and no plague cannot be told apart, which is what removes this from scoring.
Dated to the next day and named victory day, which makes it scoreable against the actual trade talks.
Related to sun-seasons-shift but names a mechanism, the poles, which that claim does not.

The most important methodological passage found so far. He states flatly that the 2020 Trump restoration prophecies were false and that those prophets missed it. That is the standard he sets for others, and it belongs beside grace-for-missed-words, which asks for the opposite treatment.
Marked contradiction. reprieve-four-years, shmita-2028-window and rapture-by-2028 all close the window at 2028. Here it ends in 2029 and the tribulation starts there. Both stand.

Worth recording carefully: the 28 April election went the other way and he acknowledges it, saying he still believes and prays even when he sees it. The prayer did not change the outcome and he does not claim it did.
Attributes it to China and dates the warning to July 2024, adding the three week outage figure that the canonical claim carries.
The averted branch restated six months on, with politics affirmed as the mechanism.
Claims the April 2025 selloff as a hit on a prior tariff war word. The prior word should be locatable.
Names BRICS as the route to it, which ties saudi-brics to the one world currency thread.
He polls the audience on whether a 1930s crash comes within the year rather than calling it himself.
Introduces another man's 2014 dream, which he endorses and reads at length.
The armed guards detail sourced to someone else's dream rather than his own vision, and specified as military rather than police.
Starting to manifest asserted without a marker. This is how borrowed words get counted as landing.
He may be told he is done on YouTube, which pairs with the stated intention to stop publishing some warnings.
